summary: Lewis and Clark County, MT tower near Helena: 1930s lookout later built as a 20-foot L-4; destruction dated 1971 vs a 1972 removal plan; only a 2016 forum post describes the site now.

facts.design: L-4 cab on a 20-foot pole tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1971 per firelookout.com; an April 1972 newspaper report describes plans to remove or destroy the tower. The records do not confirm which happened.

staffing.status: named lookout in the 1930 season (Milton Coty); two men stationed at the lookout in July 1937

visit.trail_note: A hiker's forum thread started in August 2016 describes a trail to the summit from a trailhead about 10 miles from Helena. No official source describes the route or whether it is open.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com dates the 20-foot tower to 1937. The Helena newspaper items from December 1935 and January 1936 describe it under construction and not yet finished, so completion was probably in 1936 or 1937. The event uses 1937 from firelookout.com and the story gives both.

Firelookout.com says the tower was destroyed in 1971. The April 1972 Forest Service item says it was to be removed that summer or destroyed if no bids came in. The records do not show which happened. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Weakest of the three. Build date (1936 or 1937) and end date (1971 destruction vs 1972 removal plan) disagree and the story reports both. The only description of the site today is an undated-in-body hiker's forum post started Aug 30, 2016; it is anecdotal and not an official source. The forum post places Rimini near Red Mountain, while the 1935 article says Colorado mountain is near Rimini; flag this for the editor. The forest name is Helena National Forest as printed in both lookout write-ups. A second search found no Forest Service record for the lookout. Access is not stated in any source; no access level is set.
